verse.verse_3: And by the even and the odd,
verse.verse_4: And by the night when it departeth,
verse.verse_5: Indeed in that there is an oath for a man of sense.
verse.verse_6: Bethinkest thou not in what wise thy Lord did with the 'A'ad:
verse.verse_8: The like of which was not built in the cities,
verse.verse_9: And With Thamud who hewed out rocks in the vale,
verse.verse_10: And with Fir'awn, owner of the stakes -
verse.verse_11: Who all waxed exorbitant in the cities,
verse.verse_13: Wherefore thy Lord poured on them the scourge of His torment.
verse.verse_14: Verily thy Lord is in an ambuscade,
verse.verse_15: As for man - when his Lord proveth him and so honoureth him and is bounteous Unto him, then he saith: 'my Lord hath honoured me,
verse.verse_16: And when He proveth him, and so stinteth Unto him his provision, he saith: 'my Lord hath despised me.
verse.verse_17: By no means! But ye honour not the orphan,
verse.verse_18: Nor urge upon each other the feeding of the poor,
verse.verse_19: And devour the inheritance devouring greedily,
verse.verse_20: And ye love riches with exceeding love.
verse.verse_21: By no means! when the earth shall be ground with grinding, grinding,
verse.verse_22: And thy Lord shall come and the angels, rank on rank.
verse.verse_23: And the Hell on that Day shall be brought nigh. On that Day man shall remember, but how will remembrance avail him?
verse.verse_24: He will say. 'would that I had sent before for this life of mine!
verse.verse_25: Wherefore on that Day none shall torment with His torment.
verse.verse_26: Nor shall any bind with His bond.
verse.verse_28: Return Unto thine Lord well pleased and well-pleasing.
verse.verse_29: Enter thou among My righteous bondmen!
